puberty-ages.title: When to evaluate puberty
rows: Girl: no breast by 13, no menses by 15
Bone age first. High FSH = gonadal failure

ttp-itp.title: TTP versus ITP
rows: ITP: isolated low platelets, no fragments
Platelets in TTP only for life-threatening bleed

hit-days.title: HIT, day 5 to 10
rows: Stop heparin. No warfarin before recovery

tls-ions.title: Tumor lysis ions
rows: K up, phosphate up, uric acid up
Rasburicase clears uric acid already made

acs-clocks.title: ACS time goals
rows: Transfer: 120 minutes, or give a lytic

cha2ds.title: Who gets anticoagulation
rows: DOAC, except mitral stenosis or metal valve

htn-two.title: 2025 blood-pressure start
rows: ≥140/90: two drugs, one pill if possible

cap-bed.title: Pneumonia: where and which drug
rows: No routine anaerobic drug for aspiration

pe-split.title: Pulmonary embolism split
rows: Right-heart strain alone is not a lytic

sglt2-rules.title: SGLT2 inhibitor rules
rows: Start at eGFR ≥20 if diabetes + CKD
Also if HF, or ACR ≥200 mg/g
Hold if fasting, surgery, or critical illness

na-bolus.title: Severely symptomatic hyponatremia
rows: US: 100 mL 3% over 10 min, up to x3
EU: 150 mL over 20 min, repeat x2
Over 10 mmol/L in 24 h risks ODS

hyperk-order.title: Hyperkalemia on US boards
rows: Calcium gluconate 1 g IV, may repeat
Then SZC or patiromer, or dialysis

dka-k.title: DKA order
rows: K under 3.3: replace K before insulin
Keep insulin on; add dextrose as glucose falls

preg-140.title: Blood pressure in pregnancy
rows: Magnesium prevents seizures. It is not the BP drug

sepsis-30.title: Sepsis hypoperfusion
rows: At least 30 mL/kg crystalloid if hypoperfused
Norepinephrine to MAP 65 if still hypotensive

bleed-7.title: Ulcer bleed transfusion
rows: No heart disease: transfuse under 7 g/dL
Higher threshold if active coronary disease

saag.title: Ascites tap
rows: Remove >5 L: albumin 6–8 g per liter

mening-dex.title: Adult bacterial meningitis
rows: If CT is required, drug still goes in first
Stop steroid if pneumococcus is excluded

opioid-new.title: Starting an opioid
rows: Offer naloxone if overdose risk is high

four-abilities.title: Capacity for this decision
rows: Appreciate what they mean for you
Reason, and say a stable choice

rta-k.title: Renal tubular acidosis and K
rows: Type 1 distal: low K, urine pH >5.5
Type 2 proximal: low K, can acidify later
Type 4: high K, low aldosterone effect

bili-urine.title: Which bilirubin is in the urine
rows: First 24 hours of life is not physiologic

ie-cultures.title: Endocarditis cultures
rows: Before antibiotics if the patient can wait
Prophylaxis only for the highest-risk hearts

aaa-screen.title: Who gets one AAA ultrasound
rows: Rupture: back pain + hypotension, not a clinic scan

dissection-hr.title: Ascending dissection
rows: Beta blocker before a pure vasodilator

asthma-reliever.title: GINA track 1
rows: Step 3+: same inhaler is the daily controller

copd-abx.title: COPD exacerbation antibiotics
rows: Antibiotic if purulence plus dyspnea or volume
NIV if pH is low and CO2 is high

ectopic-choice.title: Ectopic pregnancy
rows: Methotrexate only if stable and follow-up is sure

cervix-age.title: Cervical screening intervals
rows: Start at 21, not at first sex
30–65: cytology q3, HPV q5, or both q5

lung-stop.title: Stop the yearly lung CT
rows: Stop at age 81, or if too ill to benefit

epi-dose.title: Anaphylaxis dose
rows: Watch. Antihistamine is not the treatment

co-ox.title: Carbon monoxide
rows: PaO2 and pulse ox can look normal
Content is low. Curve shifts left

nac-time.title: Acetaminophen antidote
rows: NAC if level is toxic or time is unknown
Normal ALT at 2 hours does not clear it

ards-tv.title: ARDS tidal volume
rows: Use height and sex, not the scale

ipf-drug.title: IPF drug
rows: Not long-term prednisone as the disease drug

gout-flare.title: Gout flare drug
rows: Not allopurinol as the only drug
Continue allopurinol if already taking it

warfarin-only.title: Who still needs warfarin
rows: A DOAC is otherwise preferred in AF

ca-qt.title: Symptomatic hypocalcemia
rows: Long QT, tetany, or seizure: IV calcium

uag.title: Urine anion gap
rows: Na + K − Cl in the urine

hs-vs-g6pd.title: Two hemolytic smears
rows: Bite cells after an oxidant: G6PD
G6PD level can be normal on the day

b12-mma.title: B12 versus folate
rows: Folate alone can hide the cord injury

vwd-ddavp.title: Desmopressin in VWD
rows: Mucosal bleeding. PTT may be normal

dic-fib.title: DIC labs
rows: Cryoprecipitate if bleeding and fibrinogen is low

pv-hct.title: Polycythemia vera target
rows: Do not phlebotomize hypoxic high-EPO disease

atra.title: APL, do not wait
rows: Bleeding is the early death. Follow fibrinogen

pnh-vax.title: PNH and Neisseria
rows: Complement inhibitor for hemolysis or clot

gb-vc.title: Guillain-Barré breathing
rows: Vital capacity under 20 mL/kg: intubate window
CSF: high protein, almost no cells

ms-steroid.title: MS flare versus infection
rows: Old deficit plus fever: find the infection
Disease-modifying drug is a separate order

levodopa-time.title: Parkinson doses in hospital
rows: Levodopa is the strongest motor drug

ethosux.title: Absence drug
rows: Ethosuximide if absence is the only seizure

cbz-tn.title: Trigeminal neuralgia
rows: Seconds of shock in one branch
Check sodium. Young or numb: image

nms-ss.title: NMS versus serotonin syndrome
rows: Stop the offending drug in both

li-level.title: Lithium interactions
rows: NSAIDs, thiazides, ACE inhibitors raise it
Hold the drug. Severe toxicity: dialysis

ich-cerebellum.title: Which bleed goes to surgery
rows: Lobar in an older adult: think amyloid

tia-plan.title: TIA before discharge
rows: Carotid imaging, not a visit in 3 months

cord-dex.title: Cord compression
rows: Decompress. Do not wait for full staging

back-flags.title: Image the back now
rows: Otherwise no MRI in the first weeks

compartment-5.title: Compartment, do not wait for the pulse

hip-48.title: Hip fracture timing
rows: Operate within about 48 hours if ready
A fragility fracture starts osteoporosis treatment

marfan-root.title: Marfan syndrome
rows: Aortic root dilatation is the danger
Lens dislocation is the eye finding

hfpef-sglt.title: HFpEF versus HFrEF
rows: Do not copy all four HFrEF drugs blindly

tet-spell.title: Hypercyanotic spell
rows: A vasodilator worsens the right-to-left shunt

nippv.title: When to start NIV
rows: COPD flare with low pH and high CO2
Oxygen alone does not clear CO2

fluid-rate.title: Hypernatremia pace
rows: Recheck sodium. Do not drop it overnight

variceal-rx.title: Variceal bleed
rows: Band. Do not start a beta blocker in shock
Beta blocker is secondary prevention later

uc-toxic.title: Severe ulcerative colitis
rows: C. difficile test. Megacolon: call surgery

thyroid-seq.title: Thyroid storm sequence
rows: PTU first. Iodide at least 1 hour later

gdm-baby.title: Infant of a diabetic mother
rows: Baby is hyperinsulinemic and can be hypoglycemic

endo-bx.title: Postmenopausal bleeding
rows: Endometrial biopsy, not a repeat Pap
A thin stripe does not erase persistent bleeding

co-house.title: Who else was exposed
rows: Check the rest of the household

naloxone-watch.title: Naloxone wears off
rows: Methadone and fentanyl outlast one dose

thiamine-first.title: Alcohol withdrawal orders
rows: Haloperidol alone does not stop the seizure

rhabdo-ck.title: Rhabdomyolysis labs
rows: Dipstick blood, no RBCs on microscope
CK in the thousands. K can kill first
IV fluid. Open a tight compartment

dantrolene.title: Malignant hyperthermia
rows: Rising CO2, then heat and rigidity

delirium-stop.title: Delirium, first orders
rows: Benzo only for alcohol or benzo withdrawal

colon-positive.title: Positive stool test
rows: Iron deficiency is diagnostic, not screening

breast-lump.title: Lump versus screen
rows: A mass is diagnostic imaging now

series-parallel.title: Two tests
rows: Both must be positive: fewer false alarms, more misses
Either positive: fewer misses, more alarms

surrogate-order.title: Who decides
rows: Written directive that fits this choice wins

dnr-limits.title: What DNR does not stop
rows: No chest compressions if the heart stops
Antibiotics, surgery, and opioids are separate
Write each limit. Do not guess

polst-vs-ad.title: POLST versus advance directive
rows: POLST is an order paramedics can follow
A form in a safe does not travel

child-report.title: Report abuse
rows: Suspicion is enough. Proof is not
Parent or caregiver cannot veto it
Treat the injury and make the report

o2-content.title: Oxygen content versus PaO2
rows: Right shift unloads: acid, CO2, heat, 2,3-BPG

shock-3.title: Output, resistance, wedge
rows: Distributive: resistance down, output up early

murmur-preload.title: Less preload
rows: HCM and MVP get louder or longer

diuretic-ca.title: Which diuretic moves calcium
rows: Loop: wastes calcium. Thick ascending limb

gram-split.title: Gram-positive cocci
rows: Then hemolysis and one disk test

cycle-order.title: Hormone order
rows: Sustained estradiol triggers the LH surge

hypersens-4.title: Four hypersensitivity types
rows: II: antibody on a cell. III: complexes

predict-prev.title: Prevalence and the row
rows: A sensitive test is not the chance of disease
